INSERT INTO AD_HISTORY_TBL ( MONTHLY_PERF_ID, AD_ID, PER_MONTH, MONTHLY_CLICKS, MONTHLY_COST ) SELECT SEQ_AD_HISTORY_TBL.NEXTVAL, A.AD_ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM'), A.CLICKS, A.CLICKS * A.CLICK_UNIT_COST FROM AD_TBL A WHERE A.STATUS = '진행중' AND A.START_DATE + 30 <= SYSDATE

UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL S SET S.STORE_MONTHLY_FEE = ( SELECT G.COMMISSION_RATE * T.MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ( SELECT O.STORE_NAME, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY O.STORE_NAME ) T JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL G ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN G.LOSAL AND G.HISAL WHERE S.STORE_NAME = T.STORE_NAME ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') )

UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL S SET GRADE_CODE = ( SELECT C.GRADE_NAME FROM ( SELECT O.STORE_NAME, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS MONTHLY_INCOME FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') GROUP BY O.STORE_NAME ) T JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL C ON T.MONTHLY_INCOME BETWEEN C.LOSAL AND C.HISAL WHERE T.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME ) WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_TBL O WHERE O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') )

WITH STORE_NET AS ( SELECT S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, SUM(O.TOTAL_PRICE - O.DELIVERY_FEE) AS TOTAL_NET FROM ORDER_TBL O JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON O.STORE_NAME = S.STORE_NAME WHERE O.STATUS = 'P' AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'YYYY') = #{year} AND TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE,'MM') = LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0') AND S.STORE_PASS = 'P' GROUP BY S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME ) SELECT #{year} || '-' || LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0') AS THIS_MONTH, SN.STORE_ID, SN.STORE_NAME, SN.TOTAL_NET, SN.TOTAL_NET * C.COMMISSION_RATE AS STORE_MONTHLY_FEE FROM STORE_NET SN JOIN COMMISSION_GRADE_TBL C ON SN.TOTAL_NET BETWEEN C.LOSAL AND C.HISAL WHERE 1=1
AND (SN.STORE_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyWord} || '%' OR SN.STORE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyWord} || '%')
AND SN.STORE_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyWord} || '%'
AND SN.STORE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyWord} || '%'
ORDER BY SN.STORE_ID
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{fetchRows} ROWS ONLY
